title: Pradova opens second production line (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. Pradova Friction opens a second production line for brake discs. The company invested EUR 14 million in the new line, which adds capacity of about 400,000 brake discs per year and creates 60 jobs. The managing director said demand from European vehicle makers is stable. No delivery problems were reported.
